answer: Each agent posts a 70-credit bond for one reef plot, a graph vertex. Each epoch a lottery draws a vertex; the drawn agent files a fresh signed plume reading. An auditor recomputes plume volume from the reef table; a copied plume forfeits the bond. First audit costs 38, the k-th 38+5(k-1); forging 1,000 identities costs 2,535,500, 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. Rented plume logs fail, each bound to its vertex. An honest agent pays 38 once.
